articles.title: Microsoft 365 Token Replay Attacks Let Hackers Access Business Emails Without Passwords
articles.summary:
Hackers accessed Microsoft 365 environments at 79 organizations by replaying stolen sign-in sessions, letting them enter business accounts without victims’ passwords. Huntress recorded 497 successful sign-ins and more than 200,000 failed attempts during the ten-week campaign, which ran from July 14 through September 22, 2026. articles.title: Hackers Use Instagram Ads to Deploy Coruna and DarkSword Spyware on iPhones
articles.summary:

The investigation exposes a scalable spyware distribution model in which attackers exploit advertising infrastructure to reach victims during ordinary browsing.
